in_latin.name: Ted
in_latin.meaning: Form of Theodore = Gift of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Theodore – a name of Greek origin, derived from the words τϮεσ (τϮρος) meaning “gift” and κπύσ (κώρος) meaning “God.” It was originally a name given to a Christian martyr and later became popular in Christian Europe as a name symbolizing devotion to God.
